dashboards.title: Bugzila Dashboard V3.P3.006
dashboards.summary: A compact three-page motorsport dashboard focused on adaptive shift guidance, pedal telemetry and lap analysis.
dashboards.concept: Keep the most important driving information readable at a glance on the KS Pro display while dedicating separate pages to pedal technique and lap performance.
dashboards.previewNote: Preview screenshots are from V3.P3.004. V3.P3.006 keeps the same dashboard layout and telemetry behavior with the updated flat dark gray #1C1F24 background theme.

pages.name: Page 1 — Drive / Adaptive Shift
pages.description: Vehicle speed, current gear, engine RPM and adaptive shift guidance.

pages.name: Page 2 — Native Pedal Chart
pages.description: Continuous throttle and brake traces using two native Chart.qml components with live percentages.

pages.name: Page 3 — Lap Analysis
pages.description: Current, previous, best and average lap analysis with average-speed comparison.

dashboards.title: Bugzila Dashboard V2.P1.005
dashboards.summary: A single-page race dashboard that keeps the track map, session position, lap data, gear, RPM and key car settings visible at the same time.
dashboards.concept: Deliver an all-in-one race overview on the compact KS Pro display so the driver can read track position, session information and core setup values without changing pages.
dashboards.previewNote: Screenshot is from the current V2.P1.005 dashboard package supplied for MOZA KS Pro.

pages.name: Page 1 — Single-Page Race Overview
pages.description: Track map, session time, position, lap, gap, gear, RPM and quick-access race values including TC, ABS, map and fuel information.

dashboards.title: Bugzila Dashboard V1.P3.010
dashboards.summary: A three-page race-engineer style dashboard focused on track awareness, tyre condition, race timing, fuel strategy and fast-access car setup.
dashboards.concept: Split race information into three focused screens: track and race awareness, tyre and timing management, then fuel strategy and core car setup values for quick decisions while driving.
dashboards.previewNote: Screenshots are from the current V1.P3.010 dashboard package supplied for MOZA KS Pro.
features: TC / ABS / Brake Bias / Engine Map

pages.name: Page 1 — GPS Map + Race Status
pages.description: 2D GPS track map with player/opponent markers, race status, position, lap, fuel laps, pit information and live-event status.

pages.name: Page 2 — Tyre State + Race Time
pages.description: Top-view tyre state with pressure, temperature and condition, plus current, last and best lap timing with position and lap.

pages.name: Page 3 — Fuel Strategy + Car Setup
pages.description: Fuel laps, remaining fuel and consumption per lap together with quick-access TC, ABS, brake bias and engine map values.

dashboards.title: Bugzila CM2 V1.P3.020
dashboards.summary: A full-size three-page CM2 dashboard combining track awareness, pedal and tyre telemetry, and race management.
dashboards.concept: Separate driving, vehicle-state and race-management information into dedicated screens so the driver can switch context without overcrowding one page.
dashboards.previewNote: Screenshots are from the current V1.P3.020 package.

pages.name: Page 1 — Map Drive
pages.description: Track map, core driving telemetry, fuel, gap, controls and race-status information.

pages.name: Page 2 — Pedal / Tyres
pages.description: Pedal traces, tyre pressure and temperature, brake temperature, brake bias, ABS and vehicle-state telemetry.

pages.name: Page 3 — Race Management
pages.description: Lap timing, position, gap, flags, fuel remaining and race-management information.

dashboards.title: Bugzila CM2 V2RQP.P3.003
dashboards.summary: A session-focused CM2 dashboard with dedicated Race, Qualifying and Practice modes.
dashboards.concept: Present different information according to the driver's session goal: situational awareness in races, lap performance in qualifying and telemetry analysis in practice.
dashboards.previewNote: Screenshots are from the current V2RQP.P3.003 package.

pages.name: Page 1 — Race Mode
pages.description: Race-focused layout with radar, track map, session, position, lap, race control, fuel and vehicle controls.

pages.name: Page 2 — Qualified Mode
pages.description: Qualifying-focused layout with lap timing, predicted lap, tyres, session information and race control.

pages.name: Page 3 — Practice Mode
pages.description: Practice-focused layout with sector timing and throttle / brake telemetry for driving analysis.
